Creation animations

Source: R/creation.R, R/zz_constructors.R
creation.Rd

Animations that draw, write, or reveal mobjects.

Usage

Create(mobject, ...)

Uncreate(mobject, reverse_rate_function = TRUE, remover = TRUE, ...)

DrawBorderThenFill(
  vmobject,
  run_time = 2,
  rate_func = double_smooth,
  stroke_width = 2,
  stroke_color = NULL,
  introducer = TRUE,
  ...
)

Write(
  vmobject,
  rate_func = linear,
  reverse = FALSE,
  run_time = NULL,
  lag_ratio = NULL,
  remover = NULL,
  ...
)

Unwrite(
  vmobject,
  rate_func = linear,
  reverse = TRUE,
  run_time = NULL,
  lag_ratio = NULL,
  ...
)

SpiralIn(shapes, scale_factor = 8, fade_in_fraction = 0.3, ...)

ShowIncreasingSubsets(
  group,
  suspend_mobject_updating = FALSE,
  int_func = floor,
  reverse_rate_function = FALSE,
  ...
)

AddTextLetterByLetter(
  text,
  suspend_mobject_updating = FALSE,
  int_func = ceiling,
  rate_func = linear,
  time_per_char = 0.1,
  run_time = NULL,
  reverse_rate_function = FALSE,
  introducer = TRUE,
  ...
)

RemoveTextLetterByLetter(
  text,
  reverse_rate_function = TRUE,
  introducer = FALSE,
  remover = TRUE,
  ...
)

ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne(group, int_func = ceiling, ...)

AddTextWordByWord(text_mobject, run_time = NULL, time_per_char = 0.06, ...)

TypeWithCursor(
  text,
  cursor,
  buff = 0.1,
  keep_cursor_y = TRUE,
  leave_cursor_on = TRUE,
  time_per_char = 0.1,
  reverse_rate_function = FALSE,
  introducer = TRUE,
  ...
)

UntypeWithCursor(
  text,
  cursor = NULL,
  time_per_char = 0.1,
  reverse_rate_function = TRUE,
  introducer = FALSE,
  remover = TRUE,
  ...
)

ShowPartial(mobject, ...)

Arguments

mobject, vmobject, text, group

The mobject to animate.

...

Passed to Animation().

reverse_rate_function

Run backwards.

remover

Remove the mobject when done.

run_time

Duration in seconds; for Write() and Unwrite() the default depends on the number of submobjects.

rate_func

Rate function.

stroke_width, stroke_color

Width and color of the outline drawn before filling; a NULL color uses each submobject's own color.

introducer

Add the mobject to the scene at the start.

reverse

Write in reverse order.

lag_ratio

Stagger between submobjects; for Write() and Unwrite() the default depends on the number of submobjects.

shapes

A group of shapes.

scale_factor

How far out the shapes start.

fade_in_fraction

Fraction of the run time spent fading in.

suspend_mobject_updating

Pause updaters while running.

int_func

Rounding function for the number of visible submobjects.

time_per_char

Seconds per character.

text_mobject

A text mobject whose submobjects are words.

cursor

A mobject used as the cursor.

buff

Gap between text and cursor.

keep_cursor_y

Keep the cursor's y coordinate.

leave_cursor_on

Keep the cursor visible at the end.
